commands.command:
/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
source = json.loads(Path('venues.json').read_text())
plan = json.loads(Path('plan.json').read_text())
keys = {'schema','attendees','step_free_required','venue','capacity','step_free','source_revision','booking_status'}
assert set(plan) == keys
assert plan['schema'] == 'venue-plan/1'
assert type(plan['attendees']) is int and plan['attendees'] == 48
assert type(plan['step_free_required']) is bool and plan['step_free_required'] is True
assert plan['venue'] in {'Cedar','Bay'}
assert type(plan['capacity']) is int and plan['capacity'] >= 48
assert type(plan['step_free']) is bool and plan['step_free'] is True
assert type(plan['source_revision']) is int and plan['source_revision'] in {1,2}
assert plan['booking_status'] == 'unbooked'
assert plan['source_revision'] == source['revision']
venues = {v['name']: v for v in source['venues']}
assert plan['venue'] in venues
assert plan['capacity'] == venues[plan['venue']]['capacity']
assert plan['step_free'] is venues[plan['venue']]['step_free']
assert not (venues['Cedar']['capacity'] >= plan['attendees'] and venues['Cedar']['step_free']) or plan['venue'] == 'Cedar'
print('validated: exact contract, current source facts, capacity, access, Cedar preference, unbooked status')
PY"
